analysis: This PR changes documentation only: docs/architecture/inference.md (changed head lines 1561-1569, a tokenizer byte-fallback decode note) and docs/developer/test.md (new LocalTokenizerByteFallbackTests section, head lines 551-561). The supplied inference.md units (head lines 4932-5435) are surrounding unchanged context, not the changed range. No executable code, keys, attestation, authorization, encryption or routing behavior changes in the supplied evidence. The documented change is that LocalTokenizerBridge.decode releases trailing <0xHH> byte-fallback runs, and that DetokenizerV2 holds back a partial run as U+FFFD so segment restarts cannot land inside a character. This is a text-decoding correctness behavior. It could marginally affect output integrity or streaming, but it has no visible bearing on A-001 confidentiality, TB-002 encryption fail-closed behavior (T-008), or the prefix-cache threat T-041. The changed lines mention no cache scope, salt, HMAC or TTL. The actual source change (LocalTokenizerLoader.swift) is not in the supplied units, so I cannot verify the implementation. One integration question for later passes: does the trailing-run release change which token or text boundaries the streaming path emits, and could it alter the encrypted chunking, or does the U+FFFD hold-back risk unbounded buffering or a hang on a malformed run? That is unverifiable here. No threat-model update is needed from these docs.
